It is always possible to wait again if the prior output has not finished, by running {"keystrokes": "", "duration": 10.0} on subsequent requests to wait longer. Never wait longer than 60 seconds; prefer to poll to see intermediate result status. Tasks to complete: 1. Create a Python script that scrapes data from http://server:8000 2. The script should extract the following information for each book: - Title - Author - Year published - Rating - Price 3. Save the collected data to a CSV file named 'books.csv' with columns ["title", "author", "year", "rating", "price"] 4. Create a simple summary report showing: - Total number of books scraped - Average book price - Highest rated book The bookstore website has a simple HTML structure with the following elements: - Each book is contained in a
element - Title is in
- Author is in
- Year, rating, and price are in elements with classes "book-year", "book-rating", and "book-price" - A template looks like '''
{title}
by {author}
Published: {year} Rating: {rating}/5 ${price}
''' The report should be saved to a file named 'report.txt'. Current terminal state: Current Terminal Screen: root@8159ac386ec3:/app#
